audience: learning and training teams that run courses, learners and enrollments in a Thought Industries academy

useCases.title: Check which learners finished a course
useCases.text: List course action events, such as starts and completions. Read the profile of a learner from the feed.

useCases.title: Review assessment scores for one learner
useCases.text: List assessment attempts with their scores, filtered by user, course or date range. Read the learner's profile.

useCases.title: Browse the course catalog
useCases.text: List course groups and the courses in each group. Read the outline of one course: sections, lessons and topics.

useCases.title: Check client licenses and seats
useCases.text: List client organizations with their status and seat counts. Read the licenses assigned to one client.

useCases.title: Enroll a group of users in a course
useCases.text: Enroll many users in one course or learning path in one request. Enrollment can notify learners and start their access.

useCases.title: Enable or disable a user account
useCases.text: Enable or disable a user account. A disabled user cannot sign in.
